Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) in your drafts with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It hasn't been sent. I posted the same confirmation in the thread on your message in #coastal-team.

I finished Sofia's note by adding a bullet saying the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments and the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The draft is signed from you.

The Moss digest it cites is dated 18 May, so check that the saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" before you send it.
